description: manni docs meta/reference/docusaurus-schemas, run in a Docusaurus site with docs/, blog/ and src/pages/ and no manni config.

steps.description: Declare the three content roots as collections and point one override at each.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('manni.config.yaml','collections:
  - name: guides
    paths: [docs]
  - name: blog
    paths: [blog]
  - name: pages
    paths: [src/pages]

meta:
  overrides:
    - collection: guides
      schemas:
        - docusaurus:docs:3.10
        - diataxis:diataxis:1.0
    - collection: blog
      schemas:
        - docusaurus:blog:3.10
    - collection: pages
      schemas:
        - docusaurus:pages:3.10
')"

steps.description: A run can address one root by its collection name.
The blog collection gets the blog contract.
A bare run reads all three roots, each under its own override.
For a one-off run, pass the id directly.
